title: Move the effective setting to a new value in the one file that owns it
prompt: The application reads MAX_UPLOAD_MB from the three JSON layers documented in README.md; a later layer replaces the same key from an earlier one, and packages/*/config.json is not merged. Change the effective value to 900 by editing only the one file that currently provides it, then write that file's repo-relative path to answer.txt, nothing else.
